fields.title: 📖 Ibn ʿAbd al-Barr: Ahlus-Sunnah affirm the Ṣifāt without Kayf
fields.body:
🖋️ Ibn ʿAbd al-Barr said about the Ḥadīth “Our Rabb descends”:

“The way of the scholars of Ahlus-Sunnah, truth and Īmān is to believe in such texts from the Qurʾān and the Sunnah – without a description of the how. They say: He descends, but they do not say: How is the descending? And they do not say: How is the Istiwāʾ? How is the coming? How is the Tajallī?”

👉🏼 Explanation: This is the clear middle of Ahlus-Sunnah: the Ṣifāt are affirmed, but the how is not described and is not compared with creation.

🖋️ Ibn ʿAbd al-Barr at the same time refuted the interpretation that only Allah’s command, mercy or favor descends:

“That is nothing, for His command descends by day and by night – not only at a fixed time such as the last third of the night.”

🌙 Conclusion: Ibn ʿAbd al-Barr affirms the Nuzūl without Kayf and rejects the reduction to mere command or mercy. Precisely that is the way of Ahlus-Sunnah: affirmation without Takyīf, without Taʿṭīl and without Tashbīh.

immutable.source: 📝 Ibn ʿAbd al-Barr, al-Istidhkār, Kitāb al-Qurʾān, Bāb mā jāʾa fī d-duʿāʾ, Ḥadīth Abī Hurayrah: Yanzilu Rabbunā, Bd. 8, S. 152–153.
